manual_final_edits: Book collection chain, opening artifact and CTA placement recorded separately where applicable.
method: Three editorial passes, source-bounded fact checks, exact local corrections, editor examination of material findings and changed joins, mechanical and limited reference comparison. Not new full episode viewing or audio measurement.
scope: Frank Herbert's six original Dune novels. Main evidence: Dune and Dune Messiah; later novels cover Leto II's leverage, Ixian navigation and concealment, Tleilaxu spice production and the changed conditions of travel. Book continuity; no expanded prequels/sequels or film-specific Navigator physiology.
duration_gate: Measure generated voice >= 120 minutes before publication.
hash_method: UTF-8 text after universal newline normalization to LF; copy manifests separately hash raw bytes.
final_formatting: Trailing line spaces removed after local corrections; no wording changed.
